newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Volume in FTSE index puts increases.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Volume in FTSE index puts increases.

text.p: Activity in FTSE index options was relatively light again on Tuesday, but dealers noted an increase in put volume ahead of Wednesday's meeting of Britain's monetary authorities and Friday's U.S. employment data.
November 3850 and November 4000 puts were most active in the American-style index options and November 3825 puts were most active in the Euro-style index options, dealers said.
At least part of the volume in those options was tied to reversing previous positions, dealers said.
"A lot of people are just tying up loose ends," said one dealer.
Dealers also noted that 400 lots traded April 500 calls on C&W, and another 150 lots in January 420 puts. The shares were down 1-1/2p at 485p.
